checks.proves: Partner-fleet domain and route tests pass after lifecycle changes.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not alone prove mobile visuals or PostgreSQL behavior if a test path is skipped.
checks.passCriteria: All targeted tests exit zero and changed lifecycle branches have positive/negative coverage.
checks.failCriteria: Any fleet/route test fails or a changed security/state branch remains untested.

checks.proves: Registered partner-fleet bindings and encoded negative invariants remain aligned across current contracts/surfaces.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not replace live database or device evidence.
checks.failCriteria: Any binding, schema or invariant check fails.

checks.proves: Dispatch candidate/assignment and route tests pass, including current eligibility/concurrency behavior registered in those packages.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not prove PostgreSQL-specific locking if database tests are skipped by environment.
checks.passCriteria: All targeted tests exit zero and touched eligibility branches are exercised.
checks.failCriteria: Any target test fails or changed concurrency path lacks executable coverage.

checks.proves: Current DSH schema/migrations and database contract remain valid for fleet, eligibility and dispatch persistence changes.
checks.doesNotProve: Schema validity alone does not prove all concurrent business transitions.
checks.passCriteria: Both database commands exit zero on the unit candidate.

checks.proves: Governed dispatch operations remain registered and contract-bound after eligibility changes.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not prove runtime concurrency or financial projection freshness.

checks.proves: Makes every current eligibility input, transactional serialization boundary and affected frontend reader visible for final adversarial review.
checks.doesNotProve: Search output is not executable concurrency proof and cannot replace V203/V204.
checks.passCriteria: All authoritative final decisions resolve to DSH backend/database behavior and no frontend-only final eligibility rule or missing current prerequisite remains.
checks.failCriteria: A current prerequisite is absent from final validation, a frontend is authoritative, or a parallel/stale rule remains.
